notes.ids: Gendered parts: '<base>__nam' / '<base>__nu'. Sets list base ids; resolve with the current gender, else the base id.
notes.links: Equipping a part also equips its links (body -> arms + hands, top/outer -> their sleeve layer).
notes.layers: Arms, sleeves and hands sit above the clothing torso inside Shirt/Armor so arms crossing the chest stay in front.
notes.face: Frames may name a 'face' expression to show during that frame (e.g. 'dau' while hurt).
